title: TradingManifest
description: Standard schema for trading manifest JSON documents from external systems

trader_first_name.description: First name of the executing trader

trader_last_name.description: Last name of the executing trader

timestamp.description: ISO 8601 creation timestamp of the manifest

trades.description: List of active or resolved trades

ticker.description: Ticker symbol of the financial asset

start_price.description: Asset purchase price at trade start

end_date.description: Target resolution or closing date of the trade

target_price.description: The target price for determining execution or exit strategy

doi.description: Document ID (Research paper / justification source identifier)

initiation_status_metric.description: Initial health indicator status value (positive or negative)

pct_diff_current_vs_target.description: Percentage deviation from target price (positive or negative value)
